neighbours.label: something being usable for many purposes (versatile, all-purpose, multi-purpose, general purpose), as opposed to other praise for the same object such as durable, cheap or warm
fire: Campers love this all-purpose cleaner for pots, tents and boots.
The new jacket is versatile enough for hiking or the office.
He bought a multi-purpose ladder for the barn and the house.
A cast iron pan is a remarkably versatile tool in any kitchen.
The lab ordered a general purpose oscilloscope for the students.
This all-purpose flour works for bread, cakes and sauces alike.
Chickpeas are so versatile that I cook them in soups and salads.
Our team built a multi-purpose hall for sports and concerts.
quiet: Campers love this waterproof cleaner for its fresh pine smell.
The new jacket is warm enough for hiking in the snow.
He bought a lightweight ladder for the barn and the house.
A cast iron pan is a remarkably heavy tool in any kitchen.
The lab ordered a high precision oscilloscope for the students.
This organic flour comes from a small mill near the coast.
Chickpeas are so cheap that I buy them in large sacks.
Our team built a modern hall with glass walls and oak floors.

short: usable for many purposes: versatile, all-purpose
notes: Card: ' versatile' x6, '-purpose' x3, ' purpose' x2, ' generic' x2, ' universal' x2. Output: this pole promotes universal, versatility, versatile, generic. Probes: -purpose 0.56-0.58, general purpose 0.60, versatile 0.51-0.89, feedstock 0.41; shade-loving 0.02, high speed 0.01, soft 0.19, warm 0.03, cheap 0.06. 'universal adapter' reached 0.14 and 'generic drug' 0.16, so those words are weaker than the card suggests. 'A sharp knife is handy on' reached 0.23 on ' on'.
